body: ENGINEERING CHECK, 14 Nov 2026 night (verified on the owner's secondary test phone, a Samsung A35, build 153 from main cb37c62, against VM 108 at sha-004ea8c; NOT the release-candidate pair; nothing marked walked). THE STRIP'S SENTENCE CAUGHT ON THE A35: with airplane mode on, about 4 s later (the filter) the strip said "You're offline. Downloaded music still plays." for about 2 to 3 s (two samples of 0.4 s steps), as docs/31 CN-1 says. The emulator samples of the afternoon had missed it. The sentence for "server away with Wi-Fi" was not sampled.
